data.title: KBRA Assigns Preliminary Ratings to OBX 2026-NQM13 Trust
data.description: KBRA has assigned preliminary ratings to 13 classes of mortgage-backed notes from OBX 2026-NQM13 Trust, a non-prime RMBS transaction valued at $1.0 billion. The collateral includes 1,623 residential mortgages, with 94.6% being fixed-rate mortgages (FRMs) and 5.4% being hybrid adjustable-rate mortgages (ARMs). Of these mortgages, 40.1% are classified as non-qualified mortgages (Non-QM) and 45.1% are exempt from the Ability-to-Repay/Q.

data.title: ComEd, EV Ambassador Program Spotlight Small Businesses Advancing Transportation Electrification Across Northern Illinois
data.description: Today in Chicago, ComEd participated in an event at Steps Inc. Consulting with local small-business owners and community leaders to emphasize the impact of electric vehicle (EV) rebate programs, partnerships, and customer education in driving transportation electrification in northern Illinois. The gathering featured small businesses utilizing ComEd EV rebates and resources to shift their fleets to electric vehicles. This initiative aims to accelerate the adoption of EVs in the region.

data.title: Klear.ai Welcomes Veteran P&C Claims Executive Jonathan Gerdes to the Klear.ai Team
data.description: A highly experienced industry professional with extensive expertise in carrier, TPA, self-insured, and captive claims has joined Klear.ai. The company, based in CYPRESS, Calif., made this announcement on Aug. 21, 2026. Klear.ai specializes in offering solutions for claims administration, policy administration, risk management, and analytics.

data.title: AM Best Places Credit Ratings of At-Bay Specialty Insurance Company Under Review With Positive Implications Following Announced Acquisition
data.description: A credit rating agency, AM Best, has announced that they are placing under review with positive implications the Financial Strength Rating of A- (Excellent) and the Long-Term Issuer Credit Rating of “a-” (Excellent) of At-Bay Specialty Insurance Company (ABSIC) based in Atlanta, GA. This decision comes after the parent company, At-Bay, Inc., was acquired by Munich Re America Corporation. The announcement has led to the Credit Ratings being put under review with positive implications. Munich Re America Corporation is the entity behind this acquisition.

data.title: Gravitate Publishes Research Series on AI Search Visibility as Answer Engine Optimization Becomes a Board-Level Priority
data.description: Gravitate, a Portland agency, has released four new guides focusing on various digital marketing topics. The guides cover LLM SEO, AI readability, budget reallocation, and provide 33 daily methods for ranking in ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. Established 27 years ago, Gravitate is a prominent player in the digital marketing and web industry in Portland. These new guides aim to assist businesses in understanding and implementing effective strategies in the ever-evolving digital landscape.

data.title: San Miguel Sotheby's International Realty and Querétaro Sotheby's International Realty Celebrate 50 Years of Sotheby's International Realty
data.description: A recent event in San Miguel de Allende, Mexico and Querétaro, Mexico saw San Miguel Sotheby's International Realty and Querétaro Sotheby's International Realty come together to mark Sotheby's International Realty's 50th anniversary. The celebration included an intimate cocktail gathering. This event was part of the global recognition of Sotheby's International Realty's milestone, highlighting its long-standing presence in the industry.

data.title: Matan Companies Signs Two New Industrial Leases Totaling More Than 92,000 SF in Frederick, MD
data.description: In Frederick, Maryland, on August 21, 2026, Matan Companies has confirmed the finalization of two extended industrial lease agreements covering a combined area exceeding 92,000 square feet. This development underscores the robustness of the area's industrial sector and the persistent high demand for industrial spaces.

data.title: Terrance Bradford Construction in Tampa Florida Expands Construction Consultation Services Throughout the Tampa Area
data.description: A construction company based in Tampa, Florida, Terrance Bradford Construction, revealed the launch of its expanded construction consultation services on August 21, 2026. This service expansion aims to cater to the needs of residential and commercial property owners in the Tampa Bay area. The company is set to provide enhanced consultation services to its clients in the region.
